title: UI shell and navigation
description: Shared page layout: sidebar showing user's lists, top nav with user menu (settings, API keys, logout). Responsive Tailwind layout. Navigation between list view and kanban toggle.
close_reason: Complete: responsive sidebar with dynamic list loading, user dropdown menu (settings/API keys/logout), mobile sidebar with AlpineJS toggle, new list modal, toast notification system, dashboard stats, view toggle placeholder

title: API and API key management
description: RESTful API for reading lists/items and creating/updating items only. API key generation UI (user settings page), key revocation. Middleware for API key auth. JSON request/response format.

title: To-do item CRUD with HTMX
description: Serve list view (flat filterable list) with HTMX-powered inline editing. Add/edit/delete items with form swaps. Status toggle (todo/in-progress/done). Filtering by status, assignee, priority, tag. Sorting by due date, priority, created.

title: List management with sharing
description: Go handlers and HTMX templates for: create/rename/delete lists, invite collaborators by email, remove collaborators. List dashboard showing all lists the user belongs to. Real-time-ish updates via HTMX swaps.
close_reason: Complete: DB query layer (lists.go, helpers.go), CRUD handlers for lists and collaborators, HTMX templates (dashboard, list view, collaborator management), API endpoints, owner-only access controls

title: Supabase auth integration

close_reason: Completed: JWT verification, JWKS caching, session cookies, login page, auth middleware

title: Database schema and migrations

close_reason: Completed: full SQLite schema, versioned migration system, models with testing
